claims.statement: The checked-in fidelity ledger pins both accepted concept images by exact dimensions and SHA-256 digest, covers the six required review categories, and records intentional deltas so illustrative vendor content, device chrome, and pixel framing cannot override authoritative product data or neutral presentation.

limitations: Native-size comparison is a documented human visual review supported by emitted browser captures and executable structural/style assertions; aesthetic alignment is not represented as a cross-platform pixel-diff score.

Browser evidence uses Playwright-managed Chromium, a 1536 by 1024 desktop viewport, and a 426 by 923 CSS-pixel mobile viewport at device scale two. It does not claim other browser engines, physical-device chrome or input, operating-system font pixel identity, or deployed reverse-proxy parity.

The neutral-branding boundary distinguishes authoritative vendor words in source-backed role names from copied logos, badges, watermarks, colors, and trade dress. It is a product-source and rendered-asset review, not an image-recognition proof or legal trademark opinion.

Sanitized artifact text may expose an explicit user-activated HTTP(S) review link. Markdown images are rendered as omitted text, and the exercised application automatically loads no remote font, logo, image, stylesheet, script, provider, or connector resource.

WEB-07 remains the authority for responsive semantic-tree operation and WEB-08 for keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced motion, touch, reflow, and automated accessibility acceptance. WEB-09 verifies their visual continuity without replacing those gates.
